text: Back when I served me sentence in the castle dungeon, people seemed to disappear.
zh: 想当年我在城堡地牢里蹲大狱的时候，老有人莫名其妙就不见了。

text: One night I hear' one of the guards say sumthin' 'bout some #:candles:#.
zh: 有天夜里，我听见一个看守嘀咕什么#:蜡烛:#的事儿。

text: What do you know about the castle dungeon?
zh: 关于城堡地牢你知道些什么？

text: What is past the dungeon walls?

A lot.
I spent a few years of me life in that place already.
zh:
知道的可多了。
我这辈子在那鬼地方蹲了好几年呢。

text: If ya wanna hear a story ya better get me a drink, though.
zh: 不过你要想听故事，最好先给我弄杯酒来。

text: Ya don't even have a beer on ya', pal.
zh: 你身上连杯啤酒都没有，老兄。

text: Get me sumthin' to drink first!
Some say the ol' king's crypt is behind the walls.
zh: 有人说老国王的墓穴就在墙后头。

text: If you ask me, I'd rather stay in my cell than havin' to escape through a crypt.
zh: 要我说啊，我宁可待在牢房里，也不想从墓穴里逃出去。
